top_signals.title: Treasury Market Selloff Sends 10-Year Yield to 19-Month High
top_signals.summary: The US 10-year yield topped 4.75% on Monday for the first time since January 2025 as rising oil prices bolstered expectations that the Federal Reserve will hike interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Grand Canyon Flash Flood Leaves Two Dead, 15 Others Missing
top_signals.summary: At least two people have died after a flash flood in the Grand Canyon, the National Park Service said Monday. Some 15 others may be missing or unaccounted as search efforts progress. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Mexican Peso Gains Steam as Brazil, Colombia Carry Rallies Fade
top_signals.summary: The Mexican peso is finally drawing the attention of investors who have, for most of the year, overlooked the currency to chase higher returns elsewhere in emerging markets.
